blocks.text: THE MAN ON|THE BENCH...|IT WAS HIM.
THAT SUNDAY, YOU WERE TWENTY METRES FROM THE END OF THE 2010 STORY.
HOW DO YOU KNOW|I WAS THERE?|I ONLY TOLD HER.
BUT WHY HIM, EIGHT YEARS LATER? HE HAD BEEN SWAPPED. FREED.
SWAPPED, YES. FORGIVEN IS ANOTHER MATTER.
IN THIS TRADE, YOU NEVER QUITE LEAVE THE GAME.
LONDON ACCUSES MOSCOW. MOSCOW DENIES IT. FOR NOW, NOBODY KNOWS WHO DID IT.
